# Sentinel's actual scale

Every number an audit may hold this system to. Read from the token layer, so it cannot disagree with
the product. A value that is not here is a finding; a value that is here is **not** a finding, however
unusual it looks against a generic grid.

## Spacing — three tiers, not one

The token file states the tiers itself. Audit against these, never against a plain 4/8pt grid.

| Tier | Values | How to treat a use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **The scale** | 4 · 8 · 12 · 16 · 20 · 24 | Correct. Never flag. |
| **Tolerated in-betweens** | 6 · 10 | Correct for chip and card internals. Never flag there; flag at layout level. |
| **Exceptions** | 2 · 3 · 5 · 13 · 14 | Real, and each must be justified where it is used. Flag only when a new use adds no justification. |

Anything outside all three tiers is off-scale and is a finding.

Fixed dimensions that are not spacing and are never "rounded to the grid":

| Token | Value | What it is for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--h-status` | `44px` |  |
| `--h-topbar` | `44px` |  |
| `--h-home` | `24px` |  |
| `--h-touch` | `44px` | the floor. Pressable expands to it; nothing operable is smaller. |
| `--h-row` | `42px` | SuggestionRow, AllocationCard rows |
| `--h-row-md` | `56px` | ListRow, one line |
| `--h-row-lg` | `46px` | Jump-back-in / drawer rows |
| `--h-row-xl` | `52px` | holdings, compliance, figure-comparison rows |
| `--h-row-2l` | `72px` | ListRow with a subtitle — every client, thread and fund row. F-21: the most common row in the product had no token, and `lg` was already taken by the 46px row above. Named 2l (two lines) rather than renaming -lg, because the 46 and 52 rows were still raw literals in ui_kits when this landed and are wired to -lg / -xl in the same commit; the name clash is contradiction 57. |
| `--h-chip` | `36px` |  |
| `--h-filter-chip` | `32px` |  |
| `--h-cta` | `48px` |  |
| `--h-icon-btn` | `42px` |  |
| `--h-chip-sm` | `28px` | v12 · ClientChip's box and ResponseFeedback's thumb targets. Both were setting 28 by hand, the only box in the product outside this vocabulary. The visual box is 28; the TARGET is still 44 — ClientChip's own header says so and both thumbs sit inside Pressable. Naming it changes nothing visually and stops the value drifting when the row rhythm is next tuned. |

> `--h-touch` is the floor: **nothing operable is smaller than 44**. A visual box may be smaller —
> `Pressable` and `Pill` extend to 44 with a pseudo-element — but the target may not.

Easing is one value, `cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)`, everywhere.

> **Press is 0.98, and 0.94 on 42px discs.** Any advice prescribing 0.96 is
> about a different product; it does not apply here.

| `--shadow-key` | `0px 1px 1px rgba(37,31,27,0.08)` | --focus-ring is the HALO ONLY. Measured 1.22:1 against canvas (bronze at 24% composites to #e7ddd4), so on its own it fails WCAG 2.4.13 / 1.4.11's 3.0 floor for a focus indicator. Pressable pairs it with a solid --border-focus ring at --border-focus-width, which measures 6.59 / 7.24 and is what actually carries the focus state. Never use this token alone. |

> Cards carry 5% ink at 1–2px, or a 1px ring — **never both heavy**. Depth is reserved for the
> composer, the floating disc, the drawer and the phone.
